                                          Frequently Asked Questions

                                          Find answers to common questions about our services, treatments, appointments, and patient care options to help you make informed health decisions.

                                          Which is the best hospital in Hyderabad?

                                          Aims Hospitals Hyderabad is considered one of the best hospitals in Hyderabad, known for its state-of-the-art medical technology and highly skilled doctors in specialities like cardiology, oncology, and orthopaedics.

                                          Is Aims Hospitals Hyderabad the best multispecialty hospital in Hyderabad?

                                          Yes, Aims Hospitals Hyderabad is one of the leading multispecialty hospitals in the region, offering advanced care in fields like cardiology, neurology, orthopaedics, and robotic surgery.

                                          What services does Aims Hospitals Hyderabad provide?

                                          Aims Hospitals Hyderabad offers a wide range of services, including cardiology, orthopaedics, neurology, oncology, IVF treatments, organ transplants, and robotic surgery.

                                          Does Aims Hospitals Hyderabad accept insurance?

                                          Yes, Aims Hospitals Hyderabad works with a wide range of insurance providers, allowing patients to avail cashless treatments.

                                          How can I get a second opinion at Aims Hospitals Hyderabad?

                                          You can get a second opinion either by visiting the hospital or by booking an online consultation with our expert specialists.

                                          Can I avail teleconsultation services at Aims Hospitals Hyderabad?

                                          Yes, Aims Hospitals Hyderabad offers teleconsultations across multiple specialities, such as cardiology, dermatology, and orthopaedics. You can schedule a consultation via our website or mobile app or conveniently call us on 1860 500 1066.

                                          What is the cost of treatment at Aims Hospitals Hyderabad?

                                          The cost of treatment varies depending on the condition and medical requirements. For accurate cost estimates, please call 1860 500 1066.

                                          Does Aims Hospitals Hyderabad offer 24/7 emergency services?

                                          Yes, Aims Hospitals Hyderabad provides 24/7 emergency medical services, including trauma care, critical care, and ambulance services.

                                          How can I find the best hospital near me in Hyderabad?

                                          Aims Hospitals Hyderabad is one of the best hospitals near you, with advanced medical technologies, expert care, and patient-centric services.

                                          Does Aims Hospitals Hyderabad offer health checkups?

                                          Yes, Aims Hospitals Hyderabad offers comprehensive health checkup packages, including executive health checks, senior citizen health checkups, and preventive screenings.

                                          Are doctors available on Sunday at Aims Hospitals in Hyderabad?

                                          Yes, doctors are available for Sunday consultations at Aims Hospitals in Hyderabad. Availability varies by hospital location, medical specialty, doctor schedule, and appointment capacity. Patients should check the latest doctor listings and consultation timings on the Aims Hospitals Sunday Doctors appointment page before visiting.

                                          How can I book a Sunday doctor appointment in Aims Hospitals Hyderabad?

                                          You can book a Sunday doctor appointment in Hyderabad online by visiting the Aims Hospitals Sunday Doctors booking page. Select Hyderabad, review the available doctors, specialties, hospital locations, and consultation slots, and choose a convenient appointment time. Advance booking is recommended because Sunday appointments can fill quickly, particularly for popular specialists.

                                          Can I consult a specialist or book a Sunday OPD appointment in Hyderabad?

                                          Yes, specialist and outpatient department consultations are available on Sundays at Aims Hospitals in Hyderabad. Depending on the doctor roster, patients can book appointments with general physicians, paediatricians, orthopaedic doctors, and other medical or surgical specialists. Sunday OPD timings differ by department and location, so confirm the doctorâ€™s availability before travelling.

                                          Are Sunday doctor appointments in Hyderabad available for children, families, and follow-up consultations?

                                          Yes, Sunday appointments are available for children, adults, senior citizens, family health concerns, and follow-up consultations, depending on the doctors scheduled that day. Paediatric consultations, routine medical reviews, specialist consultations, and follow-up appointments are offered when suitable slots are available. Patients should select the appropriate specialty and carry relevant medical records for follow-up visits.

                                          Can I choose an Aims Hospitals location and preferred doctor for a Sunday consultation in Hyderabad?

                                          Patients can review the available Aims Hospitals locations, doctors, specialties, and appointment timings through the online booking system. A preferred doctor or hospital location can be selected when an appointment slot is available. Since Sunday schedules vary across Hyderabad, confirm the hospital address, doctor name, consultation time, and booking details before visiting.
